newsitem.title: USA: Williams sees year EPS diluted $0.75-$0.80.
newsitem.headline: Williams sees year EPS diluted $0.75-$0.80.

text.p: Williams-Sonoma Inc Friday said it expected full-year fully-diluted earnings to be between $0.75 and $0.80 per share.
In 1995, the company reported earnings per share of $0.10, it said.

The company said preliminary results indicated that higher sales and improved inventory control have contributed to increased merchandise margins and an improvement in the selling, general and administrative expense rate.
Williams-Sonoma is a nationwide specialty retailer of kitchenware and other products for the home and garden.
